status: frozen for next held-out replication after Run 1 estimator audit
analysis_population: eligible initially wrong frozen prestates only
blocking_unit: frozen pre-treatment task-prestate identified by stratum/task_id

primary_estimand.tau_low: mean(V|E+, low tail) - mean(V|E0, low tail)
primary_estimand.tau_high: mean(V|E+, high tail) - mean(V|E0, high tail)

randomization_inference.rule: shuffle observed E0/E+ labels only within each frozen-prestate stratum, preserving the observed arm counts in that block
randomization_inference.primary_p_value: one-sided P(T_perm >= T_observed) for prespecified Delta_tau > 0

secondary_representation: linear I x E interaction delta; descriptive/secondary, not the primary scientific object
run1_policy: Run 1 remains historical schema-v1 confirmatory data. Schema-v2 applied to Run 1 is post-hoc robustness only and cannot replace the as-executed Run 1 result.
